tasks.goal: Patrol the Rhine-side campus perimeter path and log progress-plaza conditions without entering restricted pharma production zones.
tasks.terrain: Gravel and paved riverbank paths, gentle levee slopes, bollards and cyclist traffic along the Rhine promenade.
success: Complete 800 m perimeter loop within 12 min
Detect and log all 6 posted progress markers
safety_stops: E-stop on cyclist proximity under 2 m
Stop at unmarked levee slope over 15 deg
Halt at production-zone boundary geofence
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward reviews the patrol log before any findings are posted to the Progress Observatory display.

tasks.goal: Guide visitors between charter exhibit stations, narrating the contribution model and measurable outcomes from scripted content.
tasks.terrain: Polished indoor hall floors, exhibit plinths, cabling ramps, dense standing visitors.
success: Visit 5 exhibit stations in order within 10 min
Respond to at least 3 visitor voice prompts
safety_stops: Stop if visitor within 0.5 m of walking path
Pause narration on crowd density over 8 people nearby
E-stop on obstacle under 0.4 m
tasks.human_in_loop: A human docent approves the narration script and can interrupt the tour at any time.

tasks.goal: Pick文献 sample trays from the intake rack and place them on the synthesis bench stations for agent-labeled analysis batches.
tasks.terrain: Lab bench surfaces, rack slots at 0.4-1.2 m height, transparent tray walls challenging depth perception.
safety_stops: Stop if human hand enters workspace envelope
Pause on force/torque threshold of 5 N
Abort on vision confidence under 0.8
tasks.human_in_loop: A lab technician confirms batch labels and releases each pick sequence start.

tasks.goal: Carry printed proposal summaries from the drafting desk to review podiums and return human annotations to the drafting station.
tasks.terrain: Carpeted forum floor, movable seating clusters, low podium edges below lidar height.
success: Payload detected and secured each trip
safety_stops: Stop on human within 1 m
Sit-down on low battery under 20%
Halt if payload load shifts beyond 0.2 rad tilt
tasks.human_in_loop: A reviewer places and signs each document; the robot only ferries, never files, proposals.

tasks.goal: Inspect the operations deck server racks and task-routing displays, reading indicator LEDs and thermal tags for the Task Router agents.
tasks.terrain: Raised-floor deck, cable trays underfoot, narrow 0.8 m rack aisles, glass display walls.
safety_stops: Stop if technician enters rack aisle
Refuse stair or raised-floor edge descent
E-stop on slip or fall recovery trigger
tasks.human_in_loop: An ops steward approves inspection route access and reviews the anomaly report before filing.

tasks.goal: Sort glass culture vials from washing racks into labeled trays on the campus greenhouse bench, handling fragile items with impedance control.
tasks.terrain: Greenhouse bench with wet surfaces, drip trays, tiered washing racks, hanging plant obstructions.
safety_stops: Reflex retreat on force over 2.5 N
Stop if human arm enters bench workspace
Pause on camera occlusion by foliage over 1 s
tasks.human_in_loop: A researcher assigns tray labels and confirms fragile-item handling mode each session.

tasks.goal: Fly a 4-drone swarm scan of the Charter Hall atrium to verify exhibit layout matches the digital twin model.
tasks.terrain: Tall glass atrium walls and skylight causing GPS-denied glare, suspended banner cables, open mezzanine railings.
success: Scan 90% of atrium volume in 8 min
Twin diff report flags layout mismatches over 10 cm
safety_stops: Land immediately on mocap loss over 0.5 s
Geofence 1 m from glass and railings
Auto-land on battery under 25%
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward clears the atrium airspace and authorizes each swarm flight before launch.

tasks.goal: Identify and log incoming material pallets at the campus loading dock and relay manifests to the Task Router for working-group dispatch.
tasks.terrain: Concrete dock apron, pallet shrink-wrap glare, truck tailgate edges, intermittent rain exposure under canopy.
success: Scan 10 pallet barcodes with 98% read rate
Log manifest within 30 s of each arrival
Zero reach past dock edge guardrail
safety_stops: Retract arm if truck moves or reverses
Stop if dock worker within 1 m of arm
Pause on camera rain occlusion over 2 s
tasks.human_in_loop: A dock supervisor verifies manifest entries before the Task Router dispatches any working group.
